# MCP tools reference

The OpenDocs MCP server (`https://mcp.opendocs.cc/mcp`) offers 41 tools. An app only sees the tools for the permissions you approved when you connected it. You don't call these yourself: you ask in plain words and the app picks the tool. See [Connect OpenDocs over MCP](../integrations/mcp.md) to set it up.

**Behaviour:** *Read only* tools never change anything. *Asks you first* tools change or remove things; apps like Claude ask before running them, and OpenDocs also requires an explicit confirmation for deleting, going public and sending for signature. *Visible to others* tools publish, share or email.

## Account and defaults

Who you are, your workspaces and where new documents go.

| Tool | What it does | Permission | Behaviour | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get_account` | Who the user is in OpenDocs: their workspaces (with role), the plan and document quota of the default workspace, where new documents go by default (workspace, project, organise mode), pending invitations, connected integrations (Google Drive folder names, e-signature) and what this app is allowed to do. | Read | Read only | none |
| `set_defaults` | Change where new documents go for this connection: the default workspace, the default project (or null to use the workspace's Default project) and the organise mode (ask: ask before creating projects for new topics; auto: create them and say so; off: always use the default project). | Read | Changes your data | `workspace`, `project`, `organize` |

## Reading documents

Find, open and look back through documents.

| Tool | What it does | Permission | Behaviour | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list_documents` | List the user's documents, newest first, or search them by words in the title or summary (query). | Read | Read only | `query`, `project`, `tag`, `workspace`, `page`, `limit` |
| `get_document` | Open a document: its title, link, project, who can open it, who it's shared with, current version number, and its Markdown (or an older version's). | Read | Read only | `document`, `version`, `include_markdown`, `offset` |
| `get_document_history` | Every published version of a document, newest first, with when and from which app it was published. | Read | Read only | `document` |
| `list_projects` | The projects in a workspace with how many documents each has and their recent titles. | Read | Read only | `workspace` |

## Writing documents

Publish, change, share and remove documents.

| Tool | What it does | Permission | Behaviour | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `publish_document` | Publish Markdown as a new OpenDocs document and get its link. | Create and change | Visible to others | `markdown`, `title`, `slug`, `project`, `workspace`, `visibility`, `confirm_public`, `tags` |
| `publish_documents` | Publish up to 25 related documents in one call (one call, never a loop of publish_document). | Create and change | Visible to others | `documents`, `project`, `workspace`, `visibility`, `confirm_public`, `tags` |
| `edit_document` | Make targeted changes to a document without resending all of it: each edit replaces exact text (find) with new text (replace). | Create and change | Asks you first | `document`, `edits`, `base_version` |
| `update_document` | Replace a document's Markdown, title or tags, creating a new version at the same link (older versions are kept). | Create and change | Asks you first | `document`, `markdown`, `title`, `tags`, `base_version`, `force` |
| `restore_document_version` | Bring back an older version of a document by publishing its content as a new version at the same link. | Create and change | Visible to others | `document`, `version` |
| `move_document` | Move a document to another project in the same workspace (by project name, slug or ID; a new name creates the project). | Create and change | Asks you first | `document`, `project` |
| `set_document_visibility` | Change a document's visibility: private (only the user), workspace (workspace members) or public (anyone with the link). | Create and change | Asks you first | `document`, `visibility`, `confirm_public` |
| `share_document` | Give specific people outside the workspace access to one document, or take it away. | Create and change | Asks you first | `document`, `add`, `remove`, `notify` |
| `unpublish_document` | Take a document offline: its link stops working but the content, history and link are kept, and it no longer counts toward the workspace's document limit. | Create and change | Asks you first | `document` |
| `delete_document` | Permanently delete a document with every version. | Create and change | Asks you first | `document`, `confirm` |
| `claim_anonymous_document` | Move a document that was published without an account (a 24-hour link) into the user's workspace so it stays. | Create and change | Changes your data | `claim`, `project`, `workspace`, `visibility` |
| `upload_image` | Store an image in OpenDocs and get a permanent link to put in a document as `![description](link)`. | Create and change | Changes your data | `data_base64`, `file`, `filename`, `workspace` |

## Files

PDF and Word exports, as download links.

| Tool | What it does | Permission | Behaviour | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `export_document` | Turn one or more documents (up to 10) into PDF or Word files with the workspace's branding, and get a download link for each. | Read | Read only | `documents`, `format`, `landscape`, `accent_color` |

## Projects

Group related documents.

| Tool | What it does | Permission | Behaviour | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `create_project` | Create a project in a workspace. | Create and change | Changes your data | `name`, `slug`, `workspace` |
| `rename_project` | Rename a project, and optionally change its slug. | Create and change | Asks you first | `project`, `name`, `slug`, `workspace` |
| `delete_project` | Delete a project. | Create and change | Asks you first | `project`, `confirm`, `workspace` |

## Team and workspaces

Needs the "Manage team members, workspaces and export branding" permission, except reading the team and answering your own invitations.

| Tool | What it does | Permission | Behaviour | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list_team` | Who is in a workspace: members with their name, email and role, plus pending invitations and auto-join email domains. | Read | Read only | `workspace` |
| `invite_people` | Invite people to a workspace by email. | Team and workspace admin | Visible to others | `emails`, `role`, `workspace` |
| `change_member_role` | Make a workspace member an admin, or an admin a member again. | Team and workspace admin | Asks you first | `email`, `role`, `workspace` |
| `resend_invitation` | Email a pending workspace invitation to the person again, for example when they can't find it. | Team and workspace admin | Visible to others | `email`, `workspace` |
| `revoke_invitation` | Cancel a workspace invitation that wasn't accepted yet: the link in the person's email stops working. | Team and workspace admin | Asks you first | `email`, `workspace` |
| `remove_team_member` | Remove a member from a workspace. | Team and workspace admin | Asks you first | `email`, `confirm`, `workspace` |
| `respond_to_invitation` | Accept an invitation to a workspace, join a workspace that's open to the user's email domain, or decline an invitation. | Create and change | Changes your data | `workspace`, `accept` |
| `leave_workspace` | Leave a workspace the user belongs to. | Create and change | Asks you first | `workspace`, `confirm` |
| `create_workspace` | Create a new workspace, with the user as owner. | Team and workspace admin | Changes your data | `name`, `slug` |
| `set_auto_join_domains` | Let anyone who signs in with a verified email at the company's domain join a workspace as a member without an invitation (add), or stop that (remove). | Team and workspace admin | Changes your data | `add`, `remove`, `workspace` |

## Export theme

The colour, font, logo and footer of every PDF and Word export in a workspace.

| Tool | What it does | Permission | Behaviour | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get_export_theme` | The look of the workspace's PDF and Word exports: brand colour, font, preset, logo and footer, whether the user may change them, plus the curated presets (with what each suits), the available fonts and the contrast rules. | Read | Read only | `workspace` |
| `update_export_theme` | Change the brand colour, font, preset, logo or footer used in every PDF and Word export in the workspace. | Team and workspace admin | Changes your data | `preset`, `color`, `font`, `logo_in_exports`, `footer`, `logo_url`, `allow_low_contrast`, `confirm`, `workspace` |

## Google Drive and e-signature

Needs the "Google Drive and e-signatures" permission, and a Pro or Team workspace with Drive or DocuSeal connected in Dashboard → Integrations.

| Tool | What it does | Permission | Behaviour | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `save_to_drive` | Save a document as a PDF (default), Word or Markdown file in one of the workspace's Google Drive folders. | Drive and e-signatures | Visible to others | `document`, `folder`, `format`, `version`, `filename` |
| `create_signature_draft` | Create a draft signature request with DocuSeal. | Drive and e-signatures | Changes your data | `document`, `signers`, `order`, `subject`, `message`, `expires`, `file_to`, `version` |
| `send_signature_request` | Send a draft signature request (made with create_signature_draft): DocuSeal emails each signer a link to sign, in the draft's order. | Drive and e-signatures | Asks you first | `request_id`, `confirm` |
| `list_signature_requests` | The workspace's signature requests, newest first (up to 50), with status and how many have signed. | Drive and e-signatures | Read only | `document`, `status`, `workspace` |
| `get_signature_request` | Where a signature request stands: its status, each signer's status (not sent, email sent, opened, signed, declined) and the details read back before sending. | Drive and e-signatures | Read only | `request_id` |
| `cancel_signature_request` | Cancel a draft or pending signature request; signers can no longer sign it. | Drive and e-signatures | Asks you first | `request_id`, `confirm` |
| `file_signed_documents` | Save a completed signature request's signed PDF and audit log (signing certificate) in one of the workspace's Google Drive folders. | Drive and e-signatures | Visible to others | `request_id`, `folder` |
